units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 14:6">Kel. XIV, 6</cite> <he>שעשה בו מ׳</he> (not <he>שעשאה</he>) one part of which he polished to serve as a mirror.
<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 13:16">Tosef. Sabb. XIII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 14:16">XIV</cite>), 16; a. fr.—Pl. <he>מַרְאוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 4:4">Gen. R. s. 4</cite> <he>מ׳ גדולות</he> magnifying mirrors; <he>מ׳ קטנות</he> diminishing mirrors; a. e.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 73:8">Gen. R. s. 73</cite> <he>היה לך מ׳ בתוך ביתך</he> didst thou have pictures in thy house? <he>שחורה … או לבנה</he> of black persons or of white?
